dep.name: WolverineFx
dep.purpose: CQRS command/event bus, saga orchestration, message handler pipeline (Worker only)

dep.name: Dapr.Client
dep.purpose: Sidecar-based pub/sub (Writer→MQ), state management (Worker saga state)

dep.name: Dapr.AspNetCore
dep.purpose: ASP.NET Core integration for Dapr pub/sub and service invocation

dep.name: FluentValidation
dep.purpose: Payment DTO validation (Reader and Writer), command validation (Wolverine pipeline)

dep.name: MongoDB.Driver
dep.purpose: Payment document storage (Reader queries), saga state persistence (Worker), idempotency records

dep.name: Serilog
dep.purpose: Structured logging with enrichment and PII redaction across all tiers

dep.name: Serilog.Sinks.Console
dep.purpose: Console sink for structured development logs

dep.name: Serilog.Enrichers.CorrelationId
dep.purpose: Correlation ID propagation: Reader → Writer → MQ → Worker

dep.name: Serilog.Sinks.OpenTelemetry
dep.purpose: Export structured logs to OTLP-compatible backends for observability

constraint.reason: Wolverine 3.x is current stable for .NET 9; saga APIs stable
Dapr 1.15 LTS aligns with .NET 9 runtime support
MongoDB.Driver 3.x supports LINQ3 and transactions on .NET 9

PreferredAgentStack.preferred-read-api: ASP.NET Core controllers for direct MongoDB queries (stateless, scalable)
PreferredAgentStack.preferred-write-gateway: ASP.NET Core controllers that route commands to Dapr pub/sub (async, fireand-forget to MQ)
PreferredAgentStack.preferred-message-bus: WolverineFx (command/event via Dapr pub/sub binding, Worker side only)
PreferredAgentStack.preferred-validation: FluentValidation (pipeline behavior for Wolverine messages, DTO validation for Reader/Writer)
PreferredAgentStack.preferred-persistence: MongoDB (payment documents, saga state, idempotency ledger)
PreferredAgentStack.preferred-observability-library: Serilog (structured JSON, CorrelationId enricher, PII redaction)

discouraged-surface.reason: Avoids lock-in to a single MQ SDK; use Dapr pub/sub abstraction.

PreferredAgentStack.discouraged-surface: Direct RabbitMQ/Kafka client SDK in Reader/Writer code

module-level.focus: Fast deterministic unit and contract checks; fakes for all external boundaries

wave-level.focus: Bottom-up: MongoDB → Reader (read queries) + Writer (command routing) → Worker (saga processing)

phase-level.focus: Full regression: all unit + wave integration + saga compensation + idempotency replay + read-write consistency

Testing.mocking-policy: Prefer FakeItEasy fakes for Dapr client; use Testcontainers.MongoDB for integration tests; Wolverine in-memory pub/sub for unit tests.

Observability.required-fields: correlationId, paymentId, path (read|write), sagaId (write path only)
Observability.redaction: Never log account numbers, full amounts (log ranges/buckets only), SWIFT auth codes, or PII. Redact at Serilog enricher level with a custom Destructure policy.

AutonomyPolicy.replan-trigger: Missing dependency surface, contradictory contract, or unclear Dapr/Wolverine version-specific API.
AutonomyPolicy.checkpoint-requirement: Every completed step must emit assumptions, commands, evidence, and next action.

DeliveryShape.shape: Kubernetes-native: Reader Deployment (3+ read-only replicas, stateless), Writer Deployment (3+ command gateway replicas), Worker Deployment (3-N replicas per MQ partition). Each pod has Dapr sidecar. MongoDB StatefulSet with replica-set. MQ broker (Kafka or RabbitMQ) managed by Dapr. GitOps-driven deployment via centralized repo.
